authorization: Human user: 继续执行下一步; assistant retrospective research choices, not trading parameters
scope: Previously explored 2023-2024 development diagnostics; no untouched-test, current forecast, trading-profit or causal claims
hypothesis: The sign of Shenzhen Component close relative to its same-date MA20 may carry price-direction information for this Shenzhen-listed stock beyond a matched constant-frequency baseline
input_features: outputs/市场环境输入准备_20261031/市场环境工程输入.sqlite
feature_choice_reason: Single Shenzhen market background proxy for a Shenzhen-listed research stock; MA20 is already prepared. No comparison or selection of other indices, lags or the other prepared columns by outcome scores
input_labels: outputs/三线研究启动_20261025/量价基线/开发期结果隔离.sqlite
input_anchors: outputs/三线研究启动_20261025/量价基线/日线特征与信号.sqlite
event: C[t+5]/O[t+1]-1 > 0; zero joins nonpositive and is counted separately
market_state_definition: engineering_value > 0 -> above_ma20; engineering_value <= 0 -> at_or_below_ma20, equality assigned below; no tolerance or threshold search
valid_feature_policy: Only the one registered feature. engineering_ready=1, exact status ENGINEERING_READY_NOT_FORMAL_PIT, finite engineering_value > -1, close_source_conflict_n=0, dependency_n=20, max_dependency_date=signal_date, dependency_first_date <= signal_date; historical/PIT/runtime flags remain 0
missing_policy: Consistent missing/cold-start/source-conflict rows or absent source rows cause explicit shared abstention; never use diagnostic_value, zero fill or another index
nonready_trace_policy: Cold-start rows have zero dependencies and NULL trace dates. Conflict rows retain a complete MA20 trace whose actual conflict sum equals the feature conflict count; no engineering value is used
invalid_feature_policy: Reject duplicate or out-of-domain dates, wrong feature ID, unregistered statuses, nonfinite values, contradictory engineering-ready/value/status/trace/flag combinations before fitting
dependency_policy: Independently verify the actual 20 unique ordered primary-provider closes against input_closes, source observation IDs/values/hashes, the current and 19 preceding observed index dates, and feature trace first/last dates before any fit
research_exception: This exact pre-audited engineering field may be used for retrospective development diagnostics although formal input approval is false; no other exception and no formal/PIT/runtime promotion
decision_time: After signal-date completed close under saved-snapshot assumptions; historical first availability remains uncertified
m3_formula: pg=(kg+20*p0)/(ng+20), exact p0 fallback if ng=0
denominator_definition: Both models use identical matured, selected-feature-valid training rows; group counts are subsets of that common pool
insufficient_training_policy: Below 100 common rows -> both models abstain for the fold; no fallback to an older fold or threshold reduction
training_policy: Expanding window; signal and actual label end strictly before validation start. Fit once and freeze values for each complete fold
validation_policy: Label end <= fold end. M0/M3 same dates and outcomes; keep prior known ex-date and development-end label exclusions
comparability: Refit M0 on the same selected-market-feature pool; do not directly compare with earlier MA-only or price-volume scores on different dates. This does not test a conditional increment above M1 or M2
primary_metric: POOLED all-overlapping mean Brier difference M3-M0; lower is better
fixed_grid: Construct i%5==0 from all 484 original development anchors starting 2023-01-03 before exclusions; intersect with actual scored dates, no phase choice
reporting: Every fold, both groups including empty ones, n/k/zero/negative/p, shared training members, exclusions, paired loss differences, coverage and all fixed bins
development_screen: A descriptive eligibility screen for later design review only: pooled Brier and pooled log loss both strictly lower, fixed-grid Brier no worse, and strictly lower Brier in at least 4 of the 6 folds. All must be evaluable. Not a significance test, profit guarantee or automatic phase promotion
followup_policy: Keep the full outcome and trial ledger; no tuning or extra candidates this round. Passing the descriptive screen only permits a separate review and preregistered next-phase design; it never opens 2025/2026 targets or approves live use automatically
